maria.partnerships: Quick sync — full-dress marketplace rehearsal tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need last-minute confirmations on press embargo, landing page freeze, marketplace metadata, and partner assets. Can everyone confirm availability?

ashley-marketing: available. Press embargo set to 2026-11-06T14:00:00Z. I'll upload final hero and alt text to the drive link below. Will also prep the press one-pager. :white_check_mark: https://drive.google.com/marketplace-assets

devin-product: landing page freeze = EOD today. I pushed the final copy to the PR: `github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/492` — please review comments ASAP. Also need a final sign-off on the feature bullets.

robert-engineering: metadata side: converting price tiers for EU + VAT handling, ETA EOD. Need the Azure/Google listing artifacts (container + manifest). @simon-sales can you send the certified artifact or point me to the SI packaging guide?

simon-sales: will DM the artifact and the partner SSO docs in 10m. Also scheduling a short co-sell sync w/ the SI on 11/08 — will invite @maria.partnerships and @ashley-marketing.

jenny-ops: rehearsal runbook (short):
```
1) 09:45 — preflight: smoke checks, auth, CDN warmup
2) 09:55 — dry-run press release embargo check (pressbot confirms)
3) 10:00 — staged publish: landing page commit -> infra deploy -> CDN invalidation
4) 10:05 — marketplace publish dry-run (metadata + artifact validation)
5) 10:15 — partner asset smoke (logos, SSO, docs links)
6) 10:25 — rollback window & incident contacts
```
I'll kick the simulated traffic at 10:02 and monitor errors. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/marketplace/rehearsal-runbook

pressbot: Automaton: embargo noted for 2026-11-06T14:00:00Z. I will post to the press channel when the embargo lifts.

maria.partnerships: Great — final asks before tomorrow: 1) everyone react with :eyes: if you will be on the call, 2) Ashley please attach final hero + press one-pager to the PR, 3) Robert confirm artifact link in this thread when uploaded, 4) Jenny runbook watchers: add incident escalation list. Agenda for the call: (A) press dry-run (B) landing page push (C) marketplace publish checklist (D) partner comms cadence.

ashley-marketing: :eyes: will add hero + one-pager in next 20m.

devin-product: :eyes: reviewing PR now.

robert-engineering: uploading artifact to `s3://redwood-marketplace/artifacts/azure-cert-2026-11-06.tar.gz` — sharing ACL with ci-service and simon-sales.

simon-sales: :eyes: got the artifact. Will forward to SI and confirm webinar invite after rehearsal.

jenny-ops: added oncall list to the runbook. :thumbsup:

maria.partnerships: Thanks all. If anything blocks EOD please tag me directly. We'll run the rehearsal at 10:00am PT sharp.

pressbot: Note: when embargo lifts, press channel will receive automated ping. Ensure final press list is attached to the one-pager.

maria.partnerships: Closing thread — final check-in 09:30 tomorrow in #partnerships. :rocket:
